financings_after_balance_sheet.what: January 2023 follow-on public offering of common stock, including full exercise of underwriters' option
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The offering closed on January 24, 2023, resulting in net proceeds of $134.7 million, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses.

warrants.quote: As of December 31, 2022, there were 8,855,963 pre-funded warrants outstanding.
